definitions.explanation: Lacking anything special or outstanding; neither particularly good nor bad. Can describe people, lives, abilities, or things. Sometimes carries a slightly negative nuance of being dull or unexceptional.

examples.japanese: {平凡|へいぼん}な⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平凡|へいぼん}な⟦サラリーマン→サラリーマン：06084_sarariiman⟧だ。
examples.english: He is an ordinary office worker.

examples.japanese: {平凡|へいぼん}な{幸|しあわ}せ⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: I realized that ordinary happiness is the most important thing.

notes:
A な-adjective from ⟦{平凡|へいぼん}→平凡：12425_heibon⟧, a compound of {平|へい} (flat, ordinary) and {凡|ぼん} (ordinary, mediocre). The word can be neutral (simply meaning ordinary) or slightly negative (implying dullness or mediocrity), depending on context.

USAGE:
When used about oneself, it often conveys humility. When used about others or things, it can imply they are unremarkable or disappointing. However, in expressions like {平凡|へいぼん}な{幸|しあわ}せ (ordinary happiness), it takes on a positive nuance of appreciating the simple things in life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平凡|へいぼん}な⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧ — an ordinary life
- {平凡|へいぼん}な⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧ — everyday ordinariness
- ⟦{非凡|ひぼん}→非凡：15600_hibon⟧ — extraordinary (antonym, using the same {凡|ぼん})

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ — normal, ordinary (more neutral, everyday word)
- ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧ — plain, understated (focuses on appearance)
- ⟦{凡庸|ぼんよう}→凡庸：20323_bonyou⟧ — mediocre (more literary, more negative)
